PART 4
Exercises

Exercise 1: given and find
A fully transposed line has phase spacings 4, 4, 8 m, GMR 𝐷𝑠 = 0.0100 m, 𝑓 = 60 Hz,
and length 20.0 km.
1 Find 𝐷𝑚 and the per-phase inductance per kilometre.
2 Calculate total per-phase series reactance.
3 Explain why this reactance is not multiplied by two.
ECE 685 | Line Parameters II 21/31

Exercise 1: solution
𝐷𝑚 = (4 ⋅ 4 ⋅ 8) 1/3 = 5.03968 m
𝐿′
𝜙 = 2 × 10 −7 ln 5.03968
0.0100 ≈ 1.24450 × 10 −6 H/m = 1.24450 mH/km.
𝑋𝜙 = 2𝜋(60)(1.24450 × 10 −3)(20.0) ≈ 9.3833 Ω
The balanced return currents are already included in the per-phase inductance
formula.
